rationale: A family-conditioned host-link null lost significance after omitting Fabaceae (p=0.18, independent seed p=0.196). Check whether the associated Pieridae×Fabaceae resource projections have separately recorded actual larval feeding on introduced Fabaceae, rather than assuming every known HOSTS edge implies ecological benefit.
species_selection: All, not a favorable subset, of the 24 Pieridae in the frozen 239-butterfly panel with >=1 accepted HOSTS Fabaceae host; selected from HOSTS+LepTraits alone.
data_sources: frozen HOSTS accepted butterfly-plant edges, WCVP native/current distributions, exact WGSRPD3
GloBI interactionType=eats records, with dated geolocation, explicit larval life stage and non-HOSTS provenance
interpretation: Only verifies feasibility of independently recorded larval use of known introduced Fabaceae in a region. Native alternative hosts, abundance, larval survival and colonization are not inferred.
limitations: GloBI observation duplication or source misclassification requires original-source verification.
GloBI observations reflect biased observer effort and are presence-only.
Truncated species API queries cannot be treated as zero records.
User-generated life-stage and feeding fields are not independently verified photographs.
Selection follows exploratory structural analysis and is not a confirmatory test.
No changes to main GEB manuscript.
stop: If field-record gate fails, do not claim realized resource tracking and do not lower quality thresholds post hoc.
